title: Forme decisions.jsonl event
description: One append-only line in decisions.jsonl. The event log the taste learner reads from. Three types: presented (starts the silent timer), decision (accept/park/reject + measured latency), correction (the optional in-place edit before accepting).

cardId.description: id of the card this event is about.

fingerprint.description: Card fingerprint. Lets the learner group events by drift identity across regenerations.

category.description: Card category, denormalized onto every event so the learner never has to join back to the card.

latencyMs.description: Present on decision events: silently measured time from presented to decision. This is 'time-to-decision' / the latency signal.

correction.description: Present on correction events: the user's edited hunks before accepting. The one sanctioned exception to read-only.

note.description: Optional free-text reason for the correction; raw material for taste rules.
